verdicts.reason: A keeps the full-width white logo band, a clear eyebrow → headline → divider → body → CTA order, and even spacing down the canvas. Its main flaw is that the headline runs close to the side edges with a tight margin. B has several problems: the white header band is cut off and doesn't span the width, leaving a navy gap on the right; the logo is shrunk to a tiny size; the body copy is jammed right under the headline with no breathing room; the orange divider collides with the top of the CTA button; and a large empty area is left at the bottom.
